text: It rained. Therefore, we stayed home.
Il pleuvait. Nous sommes donc restés chez nous.

A: Did you submit the report?
B: Not yet. I was waiting for the figures.
A: Send it tomorrow, then.

A : Tu viens ce soir ?
B : Peut-être. Je dois finir ce travail.
A : D'accord, préviens-moi.

The prototype passed its unit tests. However, the integration environment was unavailable. We preserved every raw result because the failure was external. When the service returned, the same inputs produced a complete report. Therefore, the team accepted the experiment with an explicit infrastructure limitation.
Paul a parlé à Marc après la réunion. Il était inquiet, mais personne ne savait pourquoi.
